authority: Owner delegated reasonable software decisions in conversation 2026-10-31; this records implementation defaults, not Halal or legal approval

decisions.authorization: Server checks canonical current identity, organization and permissions; wrong organization fails closed
decisions.revocation: Effective on the next protected request; technical verification target at most 60 seconds
decisions.decision_preconditions: Approved nonempty submission; any linked audit report accepted; linked nonconformities closed; independent decision maker; no unresolved conflict
decisions.decision_finality: One active decision per provider/submission; final decisions cannot be silently rewritten
decisions.certificate_issuance: Approved independent decision and approved active submissions; serialized per provider/business; no duplicate active certificate
decisions.dates: Validity includes the entire expiry business day; business timezone Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh; expiring window 60 days, consistent with earlier owner decision
decisions.external_evidence: Physical pilot device/camera/network checks and independent Halal expert judgments retain explicit evidence requirements; emulation or synthetic fixtures do not establish them
decisions.release: Manual topic branch, reviewed PR and exact committed-image verification; no CI/CD activation
